ticket.subject: Invitation not working
ticket.body_text:
Hello support,

We invited a new colleague yesterday, but the invite link says it has expired when they open it.

We have resent the invite three times with the same result. We have free seats on our plan, so that should not be the problem.

We would like this sorted before the end of the week. Can you check what is wrong with the invitations?

Best,
Freya
